checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Bottle is forest green and matte
must.why: Clear forest green with a matte look.

must.item: Bottle keeps exact silhouette, position, surface details
must.why: Silhouette and position match, but the cap opening lost its detail and looks smoothed. The bottom edge has a slight rim change.
Same scene and layout. The table grain is slightly smoothed and the image looks a bit softer.

must.item: No visible alterations outside bottle mask
must.why: The whole image was redrawn. The wood grain, the plant and the chair look slightly smoothed or repainted.

must.item: No green spill, halo, crop or shift
must.why: No green spill, halo or framing shift is visible.

faults.what: The whole image has an AI redraw softness. The wood grain and the background texture are smoothed, so the area outside the bottle is not pixel-faithful.
The cap loop and the bottom edge of the bottle are slightly altered. The cap hole detail is simplified.
The shadow under the bottle looks slightly lighter and softer.

summary: The bottle is now a convincing matte forest green with the scene intact, but the global redraw slightly softens the table and background and simplifies the cap detail.
